description: The chart, Figure 2, represents the original distribution of emotion categories in the IEMOCAP dataset. The pie chart is divided into five slices, each representing a different emotion category. The slices are labeled as neutral, frustration, sadness, anger, and happiness, and are displayed in different colors, although the exact colors are not specified. The approximate proportions of the slices are: neutral (around 40%), frustration (around 20%), happiness (around 15%), sadness (around 15%), and anger (around 10%). The chart includes percentage labels inside the slices, showing the proportion of each emotion category with respect to the number of utterances. The slices appear to be ordered by size, with the largest slice (neutral) being the most prominent. No legend is present, and no slices are visually emphasized.
